agent_explanation: Single body with e=1 launched upward at ~40.5 m/s from y=11.6 hits the ceiling within step 1 at large dt=0.0287 (40-43 substeps/step). The boundary impulse plus positional correction adds energy instead of preserving it: speed rises from 41.43 to 41.68 across the bounce with controller disabled/work 0, then energy grows each fall step to 1092.7 > 1074.16 limit. Reducing only dt to 0.001 removes the violation, confirming coarse-step contact resolution as the cause.
